whyShared: The v2 session start sheet is one screen in both portals: the web component, the handset composable
and the SessionCreate schema behind them are one source held equal by shared/questionnaire.sha256
and shared/android-questionnaire.sha256. Its contract is therefore one file, kept byte-identical in
designer-portal and documentation-portal by the same manifest. It used to live inside
documentation-portal's shared/questionnaire-form-contract.json, which designer-portal's copy did not
have, so the one shared screen was declared in one portal only.
The only portal difference is where the chosen workshop is saved, named in `storedAs` on that field:
designer-portal files a session under a DesignWorkshop, documentation-portal under a Workshop.
shared/questionnaire-form-contract.json stays per portal on purpose. It describes each portal's own
legacy capture form, which differs by design (designer-portal has a workshop type and retired the form
for this sheet; documentation-portal has a questionnaire picker and keeps the form live while
QUESTIONNAIRE_V2 is false), and its version counts that portal's history only. The parity tooling
excludes it by name and test_questionnaire_start_sheet_contract.py refuses a start sheet declared there.
